answer: The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, unlocked only after continuous uptime, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the haven of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The lagoon holds work receipts rather than names, so the signal of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
